paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz OM647 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most OM647 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six OM647-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz OM647 engine?
faqLeft.a: The OM647 is Mercedes-Benz's 2.7-litre inline-five diesel engine, produced from 2002 to 2006 and fitted to Sprinter and Vario commercial vehicles.

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes-Benz models use the OM647?
faqLeft.a: The OM647 was fitted to Sprinter (311 CDI, 312 CDI, 313 CDI, 316 CDI) and Vario (512D, 614D, 615D, 616D, 818D) — see the full applications table above for exact variants.

faqLeft.q: Is the OM647 the same between Sprinter and Vario?
faqLeft.a: The base engine is the same, but ancillaries, mounting, and commercial-vehicle-specific components differ. We confirm compatibility by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz OM647 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on OM647 rebuilds across both Sprinter and Vario applications, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you work on Sprinter OM647 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The OM647 in the Sprinter is one of the commercial vehicle applications we work on regularly, across the 311 CDI, 312 CDI, 313 CDI and 316 CDI variants.

faqRight.q: Do you work on Vario OM647 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The OM647 in the Vario is one of the commercial vehicle applications we work on regularly, across the 512D, 614D, 615D, 616D and 818D variants.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used OM647 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Sprinter or Vario if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an OM647 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most OM647 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
